Circuito de Jerez — survey report

Circuit id jerez · Spain · Spanish GP (retired, classic:true) · theme desert, day · branch cursor/jerez-survey-a1 · base sha 8954395 (merged tooling #shared-shot-tooling-5b45 + PR #1979 day-wet-lighting-b7b8, both clean) · surveyed 2026-10-15 · read-only (no js/css edits).

Summary

  • Geometry is sound (verify-track OK, 0 folds, audit-circuit all checks within baseline) but the BUILT lap is 4391.2 m, −0.8 % vs the 4426 m source trace and the researched 4.423/4.428 km.
  • Biggest finding (D1): the dressing's lap fractions are authored on the old v0 origin; the built corner list is rotated against the brief's corner names. Measured: the "Expo '92 T1" block lands on built T13, "Michelin" on T1, "Dry Sack/Pedrosa (slow right, highest point)" on T5, a left at y≈11 m, while the elevation peak (y≈17.5 m) is at T6/T7.
  • With explicit --tod day the sky is a flat saturated blue in dry, overcast and fog (D2): weather has no sky response except wet/rain/storm (those look good after PR #1979).
  • 72 frames captured (all 6 weathers at day, dusk+night dry/rain, plus eye and trackside dry-day).

Call counts (grep of emitter use): groundPatch 25, terrace 11, guardrail 11, marshalPost 11, building 11, scrub (local helper) 11, tower 9, grandstandEx 9, cameraTower 9, tyreWall 8, kiosks 8, carPark 8, palm 6, sponsorHoarding 6, spectatorHill 5, ridge 4, billboard 4, runoffApron 2, gantry 2, motorhome 2, broadcastCompound 1, fence 1, tree 1 (via olive()), bush 1 (via scrub()). every(32) scrub and every(80) olive/palm scatter fill the rest (lines 632-659). Ranked defects & suggested fixes (not applied)

  1. D1 — Dressing/brief/elevation frame mismatch high · measured + inference
    Authored fracs (scenery/jerez.js:277-300 Expo, :391-409 Dry Sack, :450-457 T7, :611-620 Lorenzo) land on built T13/T5/T6/T12 (table above). "Dry Sack — highest point of the lap, slow right" is built as a left at y≈11 m, whereas the measured crest (y 17.5) sits at T6/T7 (racing 0.40–0.45) which carry only "Turn 7 left"/descent props. Mechanism: sceneryStartFrac 0 (v0 frame) + startFrac 0.122 shift 0.8736 vs surveyed elevation expressed in the racing frame (tracks.js:94-120, def.js fromRaw). Fix: verify which end is wrong against the OSM trace (tools/track/osm-circuits.json), then re-key blocks by turn index (turns[]) instead of raw fracs, or re-seat startFrac. Corner-count caveat: Wikipedia GP layout = 15 turns, the def has 13.
  2. D2 — Day sky ignores palette and is weather-blind for overcast/fog high · measured, engine-wide
    Explicit TOD "day" hard-codes zenith [0.09,0.26,0.95] / horizon [0.54,0.68,0.90] (js/lighting/atmosphere.js:239-241), discarding Jerez's ochre horizon [0.76,0.70,0.58]. The overcast and fog branches only flatten the horizon when raceTimeOfDay === "default" (atmosphere.js:457, :491), so with an explicit day the overcast and fog shots (#45,#39) keep a deep-blue sky. Wet/rain/storm are fine (_dayWetGreyDeck). Fix (engine, not circuit): apply the horizon flatten + _dayWetGreyDeck-style grey for overcast/fog at any non-night TOD; blend track pal horizon into the explicit-day sky. Caveat: players using the default TOD get the palette path, which this survey did not capture.
  3. D3 — Terrain ends in a hard ledge at the horizon medium · measured
    Every frame shows a straight ochre/brown band stopping against the sky; at dusk-rain f83 (#66) it reads as a curved wall. Mechanism: terrainOuter:110 (jerez.js:43) with no skirt/fade to the fog colour, in a circuit with 17 m relief. Fix: raise terrainOuter or add a fog-matched skirt; confirm fog colour matches the horizon (fogColor [0.74,0.70,0.60]).
  4. D4 — Overlapping stand boxes at Michelin/T1 medium · measured
    clip-audit: 6.0 m, 1574 m³ box×box overlap at frac 0.018 (the Michelin block, scenery/jerez.js:328-362 incl. grandstandEx(0.1300…), terrace(0.1580…)); engine-baselined (11) but the largest by 3×. Fix: split/shrink the overlapping bay or move terrace(0.1580,0.1740).
  5. D5 — Night/dusk lighting artefacts medium · measured
    Light pools on terrain are visibly quantised into stepped cells (#55,#58,#70, dusk #50); jerez has night:false/lamp:"none" yet pit lamps and wide pools appear (generic night fallback); and a pink-lit hospitality block appears at the right of the f50 night frames (#58,#70, racing ≈0.5 → authored 0.63 farm building(K(0.6300),-1,118…) at scenery/jerez.js:489-491 — guess; may be a lit window/emissive tint). Fix: renderer/lighting issue (use renderer-debug / lighting-tuner); for Jerez add real lamps or declare night scenery if night races are wanted.
  6. D6 — Ridge "pyramids" low · measured
    ridge(…,58×24,h≈7-12 m) (scenery/jerez.js:419-425, 441-443) renders as sharp-edged triangular prisms standing proud of terrain (#09 right side, #03). Reads as props, not landforms. Fix: lower height / rounder profile or use terrain shaping.
  7. D7 — Flat rectangular groundPatch slabs low · measured
    slab(w,d) patches (scenery/jerez.js:80, e.g. 209, 215, 271, 317-318, 342, 561, 587) have hard polygon edges: the huge pale slab in #06 (f83) and the grey reflective sheet in wet #66, plus a hard-edged yellow patch in #14. Fix: feather via smaller overlapping patches or the texture mix; reflective under rain suggests the patch uses a glossy road material.
  8. D8 — Built length short by ~35 m (−0.8 %) low · measured
    4391.2 m built vs 4426/4428 m source; likely chord smoothing of 80 sparse control points (jerez.js:44). T1/T2 collapse to one corner in corners(); min node radius 7.05 m < half-width 7.5 m at node 31 (T2 region), so the inner edge is at the fold limit. Fix: densify the control points near T1-T2 or widen the R.
  9. D9 — Black tyre-wall stacks and seat colours low · cosmetic
    tyreWall(...,TYRE_CAP) reads as black boxes with no cap colour at distance (#14, #02) and stand seats are saturated rainbow vs the brief's "bleached" palette (§2). Marginal; engine kit.
  10. D10 — Guard-drop line contradicts the file's own rule low · measured
    verify-track prints guard drops: tree=2 although the header (scenery/jerez.js:46-50) says it must read zero. Probably the olive() via tree() path at hot fracs.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Default time-of-day (palette-driven sky) — shot.mjs only offers day/dawn/dusk/night, so the in-game default look was not captured; D2 applies to explicit day.
  • No dawn, no night storm, no dusk/night for wet/fog/overcast, no eye/trackside outside dry day; no frames at Dry Sack, Sito Pons, Expo or Lorenzo specifically (the six lap positions miss the corners D1 is about). Matrix trimmed to keep capture to ~25 min.
  • Real-world lap order/turn names, real elevation profile and the true location of the start line were not verified against an external source beyond Wikipedia lap lengths/turn counts; D1 may be a brief naming issue, not a code bug.
  • Frame file names use the gallery's <nn>-<view>-fNN-<tod>-<condition> order (tod before weather) because build-gallery.cjs's WEATHER_TAIL parses tod-weather; the brief's weather-tod order would mis-parse. storm is missing from WEATHER_TAIL in tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:42, so storm frames may group under an "unknown" time-of-day (see gallery check).
  • JPEG (1024 px) rather than PNG, to keep the branch small; original PNGs/capture JSON stay local.
  • graph-parity and driving-physics were not run.
